requirements.summary: Finite settings and C3 components are design intent with no selected executable template.
requirements.remainingWork: A separate code-generation service must read the blueprint and implement and verify the services. Studio application generation remains unsupported.

requirements.summary: Web app: browser client where link creators shorten and manage links.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: Shorten API: validates destinations, allocates short codes and stores links.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: Redirect service: resolves short codes from cache or database and answers with a redirect.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: Analytics worker: consumes click events and writes aggregates.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: CDN: terminates visitor traffic and caches redirects for a short edge max-age.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: Links database: authoritative short code to destination mapping (PostgreSQL).
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: Link cache: Redis cache of hot short codes.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: Click events: asynchronous queue between redirects and analytics.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: Analytics store: ClickHouse column store for click aggregates.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: URL reputation API: external check that a destination is not malicious.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: Link platform: group frame around Shorten API and Redirect service.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: About 100 reads per write: cache-aside with in-process L1 plus Redis, single-flight stampede protection, 302 with short edge max-age, batched asynchronous click publishing.
requirements.remainingWork: Design intent only; application implementation and verification remain later.

requirements.summary: Shorten: rate-limit callers, check destination reputation, allocate a range-based base62 code and persist the link.
requirements.remainingWork: Implement link creation, validation and code allocation within the Shorten API. No runtime is supplied.

requirements.summary: Redirect: resolve the code cache-first, fall back to the database on a miss, answer 302 and publish a click event.
requirements.remainingWork: Implement resolution, the redirect response and click publishing within the Redirect service. No runtime is supplied.

requirements.summary: Analytics: consume click batches and roll them up per link and hour.
requirements.remainingWork: Implement click aggregation within the Analytics worker. No runtime is supplied.
